gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.

gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: The players are gearing ___ for the final.
gaps.explanation: gear up for = prepare for a big event.

gaps.sentence: She always gets round ___ washing up by promising to do it later.
gaps.explanation: get round to = finally find time for; here: avoid a duty — test the preposition after get round.

gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
He loves showing ___ his new car to the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: show off = try to impress people with your abilities/possessions.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.
